nodes.label: Base44 Data Entities
nodes.rationale: Eight entities power the app: Transaction (with source field: cron_salary, cron_recurring), Budget (with isRecurring for auto-replication), Goal (with progressMode manual/linked), Card (credit cards), Rule (auto-categorization), Template (transaction templates), FixedTemplate (cron-generated recurring), Setting (key-value config). All use real-time subscribe.

nodes.label: React Query → Base44 SDK → MongoDB Data Architecture
nodes.rationale: Cloud-first architecture: Component → React Query (30s cache) → Base44 SDK → MongoDB. localStorage serves as offline fallback. First-time sync migrates localStorage data to cloud when cloud is empty. Deduplication runs automatically once per session via _autoDeduplicate() in initStore().

nodes.label: Base44 Cron Backend Functions
nodes.rationale: Five Deno serverless functions: generateRecurring (cron day 1, generates FixedTemplate transactions), generateSalary (cron day 5, generates monthly salary), generateRecurringBudgets (cron day 1, replicates recurring budgets), sendInvoiceReminder (cron daily, 3 days before due), sendBudgetAlert (cron daily, when budget exceeded). Maximum 50 functions per project.

nodes.label: Modular Store Refactoring
nodes.rationale: The original 866-line store.js was refactored into modules under src/lib/store/: helpers.js, cards.js, rules.js, templates.js, settings.js, clearAllData.js, dedup.js. A barrel file (store.js) re-exports all, maintaining the '@/lib/store' import path.

nodes.label: CSV Installment Series Expansion
nodes.rationale: expandInstallmentSeries() detects installment patterns like '5/10' in CSV descriptions and generates all installments (retroactive, current, and future), each labeled with _seriesLabel. Deduplication marks already-existing installments as _duplicateSeries.

nodes.label: rattio_gestao_v5.html Legacy Reference
nodes.rationale: Original 487KB HTML file kept in repo for visual reference. Contains the full legacy implementation with sidebar, dashboard, transaction modal, calendar, goals, budgets, reports, settings, global search, and CSV import.
